review_candidates.title: SYSTEMS & NETWORK ENGINEER
review_candidates.company: CiSS Communication Information Systems and Supplies
review_candidates.description_excerpt: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Design, implement, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, server, virtualization, and security infrastructures. • Design and build networks from initial requirements through implementation, testing, documentation, and production deployment. • Configure and troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 enterprise networks. • Configure and troubleshoot routing technologies. • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise switches from Aruba, HPE/HP, Cisco, Alca
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: • Design and build networks from initial requirements through implementation, testing, documentation, and production deployment. • Ability to design complete infrastructure solutions based on technical and business requirements. QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. • Three to five years of experience in a similar role and field. • Strong hands-on professional experience in systems and network administration. SELECTION PROCESS • Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a written and/or hands-on technical assessment as part of the selection process.
